classification.difficultyReason: Form the open-box area expression with an unknown height and solve a linear equation.

content.prompt:
The outside of this open box has a total area of $465\text{ cm}^2$.

Work out the value of $x$.

answer.worked:
There is no top, so the area is the base and four sides.
$$\begin{align*}465&=15\times15+4(15x)\\465&=225+60x\\60x&=240\\x&=4\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
